2026-11-24.title: Fourth Tuesday of the Dedication of the Church
2026-11-24.readTitle: Readings of the day (Syro-Malabar Liturgical Calendar)
readings: A chosen race, a holy nation
2026-11-24.verse: I have other sheep that do not belong to this fold. I must bring them also, and they will listen to my voice. So there will be one flock, one shepherd.
theo: Peter applies to the baptised the titles God gave Israel at Sinai: “a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's own people,” called “out of darkness into his marvelous light.” Once we were “not a people”; now we are God's people.

Jesus is the gate and the Good Shepherd who lays down his life for the sheep. He has “other sheep that do not belong to this fold”; his desire is “one flock, one shepherd.” As the year ends the Church prays for her unity and for all who do not yet know the Shepherd's voice.
outline: Ask: whose voice do you follow most during the day?
Baptism makes us a royal priesthood.
Point 2 · The gate and the Shepherd
Through Christ we find life in abundance.
Pray and work for Christian unity and mission.
live: Pray today for the unity of all Christians, especially in Kerala.
Tell someone one thing God has done for you.
2026-11-24.prayer: Good Shepherd, you laid down your life for your sheep. Gather all your scattered children into one flock, and make us a holy people who proclaim your marvellous light. Amen.

quick: Baptism makes us God's own people.
Christ is the gate and the Good Shepherd.
His desire: one flock, one shepherd.
2026-11-24.question: Do I recognise the Shepherd's voice amid other voices?

homily: Dear friends, Peter gives to the baptised the titles God gave Israel at Sinai: you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's own people, in order that you may proclaim the mighty acts of him who called you out of darkness into his marvellous light (1 Peter 2:9). Once you were not a people; now you are God's people.

Jesus is the gate for the sheep: I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly. I have other sheep that do not belong to this fold; I must bring them also, so there will be one flock, one shepherd (John 10:10, 16).

Royal priesthood means that our whole life is an offering to God: work, family, sufferings. Today, at the Holy Qurbana or in prayer at home, offer your whole day as a gift, and invite back into the flock one sheep who has drifted away. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus is the good shepherd who wants to gather all his sheep together. Today invite a friend who is alone to join your game!

intro: A chosen people and the Good Shepherd who gathers all.

sub: At Sinai God called Israel a priestly kingdom.
Peter gives this dignity to the baptised.
q: But you shall be for me a priestly kingdom and a holy nation.
I am the gate. Whoever enters by me will be saved, and will come in and go out and find pasture.
points.apply: Offer your day as a priestly sacrifice.

sub: The thief destroys; the Shepherd gives life.
He lays down his life for the sheep.
q: He will feed his flock like a shepherd; he will gather the lambs in his arms.
The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly. I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
points.apply: Name one “thief” that steals your peace and refuse it.

sub: God promised one shepherd for his people.
Christ desires the unity of all.
q: My servant David shall be king over them; and they shall all have one shepherd.
So there will be one flock, one shepherd.

concl: We are God's own people, gathered by the Shepherd.
Let us listen to his voice and pray for one flock.
2026-11-24.resolve: Pray Jesus' prayer for unity (John 17:21) daily this week.
